title: Catpilot allow/deny list export, version 1 (experimental)
description: A generic allow/deny list of a company's enforcement rules, written by `tools/validate_overlay.py export` for a gateway or policy engine to load. EXPERIMENTAL: the format may change in any release, with a note in the changelog. allow lists are approved values (anything unlisted is outside policy); deny lists are protected values. Each entry carries the rule id and the resolved mode (monitor, ask, block). An active exception appears with its exception_id and expires_on, and a consumer must stop honoring it at that date; an expired exception is not written. The file holds the company's enforcement values, so treat it like the rules file. It never carries the salt, the source hash, an owner, an approver role or any model-facing text. MCP server names are not exported: the rules file has no rule kind for them yet.

expires_on.description: The rules file's expiry. After it the rules are stale and should be treated as monitor-only.

except.description: Protected-branch entries only: branches an active exception stops protecting.
